walkthrough.title: Get Started with Babel TCC
walkthrough.description: See code in your own language in four short steps. No project needed.
walkthrough.enableTranslation.title: Turn translation on
walkthrough.enableTranslation.descriptio:
Translation is off, so code opens exactly as it is on disk. Turn it on to follow the next steps. This step only shows while translation is off.
[Turn Translation On](command:babel-tcc.toggle)
walkthrough.chooseLanguage.title: Choose your language
walkthrough.chooseLanguage.description:
Pick the natural language the code is shown in. Only the view is translated: your files on disk stay exactly as they are.
[Select Language](command:babel-tcc.selectLanguage)
walkthrough.openExample.title: Open an example
walkthrough.openExample.description:
Pick one of six short examples, one for each supported programming language. It opens already translated, even with no folder open.
[Open Example](command:toSide:babel-tcc.openExample)
walkthrough.editAndSave.title: Edit, save and see the original
walkthrough.editAndSave.description:
Change something in the translated example and save it (Ctrl+S, or Cmd+S on macOS). It is saved in the original programming language, so it still compiles and runs as usual. Then compare it with the original.
[Show Original Code](command:toSide:babel-tcc.showOriginal)
walkthrough.traduAnnotations.title: Translate names with tradu
walkthrough.traduAnnotations.description:
Keywords are translated automatically. Names of classes, methods and variables are translated with a tradu comment: // tradu in C#, # tradu in Python. Only these two languages support it. The "Hello, World" example already uses it.
[Learn about tradu](https://github.com/NFAsylum/babel-tcc#sistema-tradu)
configuration.title: Babel TCC
config.language.enum.ptBrAscii: Brazilian Portuguese without accents, for environments that cannot display accented characters.
config.language.enum.arSa: Arabic (Saudi Arabia). Written right to left.
config.translationsPath.description: Absolute path to the babel-tcc-translations repository. If empty, auto-detects as sibling folder of the workspace or uses embedded translations.
config.readonly.description: Open translated views in readonly mode (prevents accidental edits to the original file).
config.languageOverrides.description: Override target language per programming language. Keys are programming language names (e.g. 'CSharp', 'Python'), values are language codes (e.g. 'pt-br', 'es-es'). Falls back to babel-tcc.language if no override is set.
Target language for Portugol Studio files
